delivery_rule.en: One box every two months, packed with two months of goods. Delivered on its own it pays its way on every plan except: Every two months · ages 12–14 on the 12-month plan; Every two months · ages 15–18, first shave on the 12-month plan. Those boxes ride inside another Afya box delivered to the same household (one delivery, no extra delivery cost) or are collected in store. Monthly delivery is not offered: a one-month basket cannot carry packing and delivery.
delivery_rule.sw: Sanduku moja kila baada ya miezi miwili, lenye bidhaa za miezi miwili. Likiletwa peke yake linalipa gharama zake kwenye kila mpango isipokuwa: Kila miezi miwili · miaka 12–14 kwenye mpango wa miezi 12; Kila miezi miwili · miaka 15–18, kunyoa kwa mara ya kwanza kwenye mpango wa miezi 12. Masanduku hayo husafirishwa ndani ya sanduku lingine la Afya linaloletwa kwa kaya hiyohiyo (usafirishaji mmoja, bila gharama ya ziada ya usafirishaji) au huchukuliwa dukani. Kuleta kila mwezi hakutolewi: kikapu cha mwezi mmoja hakiwezi kubeba gharama za kufunga na kusafirisha.

who.en:
Kijana is the box for a teenage boy aged 12 to 18. It handles puberty without awkward conversations: soap and an antiperspirant for the body odour that starts with puberty, a gentle face wash for spots, fluoride toothpaste and a fresh brush, body lotion, a pocket sanitiser and a mosquito repellent. From about 15 it adds razors and shaving foam for the first shave. The first box brings what sport needs: a water bottle, plasters, an instant cold pack for sprains and a nail clipper, plus a treated net.

Why. Puberty switches on the sweat glands and oil glands; body odour and acne are the commonest reasons teenage boys are teased, and both respond to simple daily care. WHO advises at least an hour of moderate-to-vigorous activity a day for adolescents, and most do less; boys who play football in Dar heat need water and basic first aid. WHO recommends twice-daily brushing with a 1,000–1,500 ppm fluoride toothpaste; teenagers drink more sugary sodas than younger children. Insecticide-treated nets are one of WHO’s two core malaria protections. Razor bumps are common in boys with tightly curled hair, and the shaving items follow dermatology advice on shaving with the grain, on softened skin, with a fresh blade.

Medicines. The only medicine in the list is benzoyl peroxide 2.5% gel for acne that a wash alone does not settle. It is supplied by the partner pharmacy on its advice and is not priced in the box.

When to see a clinic. Acne that scars or has not improved after two months, a sports injury with severe pain, a misshapen joint or inability to stand, and any lump, pain or swelling in the testicles, which needs a doctor the same day.
who.sw:
Kijana ni sanduku la mvulana balehe wa miaka 12 hadi 18. Linashughulikia balehe bila mazungumzo ya aibu: sabuni na roll-on ya kuzuia jasho kwa harufu ya mwili inayoanza na balehe, sabuni laini ya uso kwa chunusi, dawa ya meno yenye floraidi na mswaki mpya, losheni ya mwili, kitakasa mikono cha mfukoni na dawa ya kufukuza mbu. Kuanzia takriban miaka 15 linaongeza nyembe na povu la kunyolea kwa kunyoa kwa mara ya kwanza. Sanduku la kwanza linaleta mahitaji ya michezo: chupa ya maji, plasta, kifurushi cha baridi cha papo hapo kwa misuli iliyoteguka na kikata kucha, pamoja na chandarua chenye dawa.

Kwa nini. Balehe huwasha tezi za jasho na za mafuta; harufu ya mwili na chunusi ndizo sababu za kawaida zaidi za wavulana balehe kudhihakiwa, na zote hupungua kwa utunzaji rahisi wa kila siku. WHO inashauri vijana kufanya angalau saa moja ya shughuli za mwili za wastani hadi nguvu kila siku, na wengi hufanya kidogo; wavulana wanaocheza mpira katika joto la Dar wanahitaji maji na huduma ya kwanza ya msingi. WHO inapendekeza kupiga mswaki mara mbili kwa siku kwa dawa ya meno yenye floraidi ya ppm 1,000–1,500; vijana hunywa soda zenye sukari zaidi kuliko watoto wadogo. Vyandarua vyenye dawa ni mojawapo ya kinga kuu mbili za malaria za WHO. Vipele vya kunyoa ni vya kawaida kwa wavulana wenye nywele zilizojikunja sana, na bidhaa za kunyoa zinafuata ushauri wa madaktari wa ngozi: kunyoa kufuata mwelekeo wa nywele, kwenye ngozi iliyolainishwa, kwa wembe mpya.

Dawa. Dawa pekee kwenye orodha ni jeli ya benzoyl peroxide 2.5% kwa chunusi ambazo sabuni laini pekee haizipunguzi. Hutolewa na famasia mshirika kwa ushauri wake na haina bei ndani ya sanduku.

Wakati wa kwenda kliniki. Chunusi zinazoacha makovu au ambazo hazijapungua baada ya miezi miwili, jeraha la michezo lenye maumivu makali, kiungo kilichopinda au kushindwa kusimama, na uvimbe wowote, maumivu au kuvimba kwa korodani, jambo linalohitaji daktari siku hiyohiyo.

clinic_line.en: Whether he uses an acne gel, and any other medicine, is decided by his clinic or the partner pharmacist; Afya does not sell medicines. A sports injury with severe pain or a misshapen joint, and any pain or swelling in the testicles, need a clinic the same day.
clinic_line.sw: Kama atatumia jeli ya chunusi, na dawa nyingine yoyote, huamuliwa na kliniki yake au mfamasia mshirika; Afya haiuzi dawa. Jeraha la michezo lenye maumivu makali au kiungo kilichopinda, na maumivu au uvimbe wowote wa korodani, vinahitaji kliniki siku hiyohiyo.

why.en: Puberty switches on the sweat glands of the armpits and groin, and bacteria on that sweat make body odour. A daily wash with soap and water, and a second after sport, is the main control. A plain bar is enough; it does not need to be antibacterial.
why.sw: Balehe huwasha tezi za jasho za kwapani na kinenani, na bakteria kwenye jasho hilo husababisha harufu ya mwili. Kuoga kila siku kwa sabuni na maji, na mara ya pili baada ya michezo, ndiyo njia kuu ya kuidhibiti. Kipande cha kawaida kinatosha; hakihitaji kuwa cha kuua vijidudu.

items.qty_formula: 2 showers a day × 60 days × about 4 g ≈ 480 g, + about 1 extra shower after sport on 30 days ≈ 600 g (planning assumption)

why.en: Underarm odour begins with puberty, often before a teenager notices it, and it is a common cause of teasing at school. An antiperspirant roll-on once a day on clean, dry skin controls both sweat and smell. Roll-ons are used instead of sprays: less is inhaled and a 50 ml bottle lasts about a month.
why.sw: Harufu ya kwapani huanza na balehe, mara nyingi kabla kijana hajaitambua, na ni chanzo cha kawaida cha kudhihakiwa shuleni. Roll-on ya kuzuia jasho mara moja kwa siku kwenye ngozi safi na kavu hudhibiti jasho na harufu. Roll-on hutumika badala ya spray: kidogo huvutwa puani na chupa ya ml 50 hudumu takriban mwezi mmoja.

items.qty_formula: 1 × 50 ml lasts about a month at one use a day × 2 months

why.en: Most teenagers get some acne as oil glands enlarge in puberty. Washing the face twice a day with a mild cleanser and lukewarm water, without scrubbing or squeezing spots, is the first step and is enough for mild spots. Acne that leaves scars, is painful or has not improved after two months of care needs a clinician.
why.sw: Vijana wengi hupata chunusi kiasi tezi za mafuta zinapokua wakati wa balehe. Kuosha uso mara mbili kwa siku kwa sabuni laini na maji ya uvuguvugu, bila kusugua wala kukamua chunusi, ndiyo hatua ya kwanza na inatosha kwa chunusi chache. Chunusi zinazoacha makovu, zinazouma au ambazo hazijapungua baada ya miezi miwili ya utunzaji zinahitaji mtaalamu wa afya.

why.en: WHO recommends brushing twice a day with a fluoride toothpaste of 1,000–1,500 ppm. Teenagers snack and drink sugary sodas more than younger children, and gum bleeding is common in puberty; fluoride and careful brushing protect both teeth and gums. Spit out after brushing; do not rinse.
why.sw: WHO inapendekeza kupiga mswaki mara mbili kwa siku kwa dawa ya meno yenye floraidi ya ppm 1,000–1,500. Vijana hula vitafunio na kunywa soda zenye sukari zaidi kuliko watoto wadogo, na fizi kutoa damu ni jambo la kawaida wakati wa balehe; floraidi na kupiga mswaki kwa uangalifu hulinda meno na fizi. Tema baada ya kupiga mswaki; usisukutue.

name.sw: Dawa ya kufukuza mbu kwa jioni

why.en: Teenagers are outdoors in the evening, studying or at sport, before they are under a net. WHO’s core malaria protection is the insecticide-treated net; a repellent covers the evening hours. Use a product whose label states the active ingredient.
why.sw: Vijana huwa nje jioni, wakijisomea au michezoni, kabla ya kulala ndani ya chandarua. Kinga kuu ya malaria kwa mujibu wa WHO ni chandarua chenye dawa; dawa ya kufukuza mbu hulinda saa za jioni. Tumia bidhaa ambayo lebo yake inaonyesha kiambato hai.

name.sw: Nyembe za kunyoa kwa mara ya kwanza

why.en: Facial hair usually starts in the mid-teens. Razor bumps are common in boys with tightly curled hair: shaving in the direction the hair grows, on skin softened with water and foam, with a fresh blade and few strokes, prevents most of them (dermatology guidance, not re-opened). A boy who does not shave yet, or uses clippers, removes this line in the app.
why.sw: Ndevu kwa kawaida huanza katikati ya ujana. Vipele vya kunyoa ni vya kawaida kwa wavulana wenye nywele zilizojikunja sana: kunyoa kufuata mwelekeo wa nywele, kwenye ngozi iliyolainishwa kwa maji na povu, kwa wembe mpya na kupitisha mara chache, huzuia vingi (mwongozo wa madaktari wa ngozi, haujafunguliwa upya). Kijana ambaye bado hanyoi, au anayetumia mashine, huondoa bidhaa hii kwenye programu.

services_note.en: bp-check: height, weight, BMI and blood pressure at the Afya Check in store, free; the reading goes on a chart in the app. puberty-talk: a private talk in store with a male adviser at about 12 and 15, free. dental-check: a six-monthly check-up with a partner dentist as an add-on; no quote yet (R7).
services_note.sw: bp-check: urefu, uzito, BMI na shinikizo la damu kwenye Afya Check dukani, bure; kipimo huwekwa kwenye chati kwenye programu. puberty-talk: mazungumzo ya faragha dukani na mshauri mwanaume akiwa na takriban miaka 12 na 15, bure. dental-check: uchunguzi wa meno kila miezi sita kwa daktari wa meno mshirika kama nyongeza; bado hakuna bei (R7).

pricing_rule.formula: D4 (10 Nov 2026): core price = shelf value of the box goods × (1 − 3% / 6% / 9% for the 1 / 6 / 12-month plans), nearest 500, never above shelf; packing (S 3,500 · M 5,000) and one delivery (3,500) included. Check: price − goods at landed cost (R3 shares: brand 78%, pharm 72%, own 50%) − packing − delivery − 1% points ≥ 0.
pricing_rule.note: Medicines are listed but sold by the licensed partner pharmacy and not priced in the box (B4). The premium and luxury items are their own line at shelf price, outside the saving.
